notes: Cover panel re-shoot of varq-17-firozi: standing, full length, headroom for the tall crop.
prompt: Editorial fashion photograph for an Indian handloom label's festive lookbook. Tall vertical 9:16 frame.
GARMENT (a real product; match the reference photos exactly, including colours, borders and motifs):

- Saree: the deep shaola-teal mul cotton saree from the first three references, printed all over with a delicate gold foil jaal of scalloped lines and tiny dots, edged with gold samosa lace and finished with dark navy tassels. Soft, matte, airy.
- Blouse: the gold sequinned and embroidered blouse from the last two references, with short cap sleeves and a V neckline.
- Pallu over the left shoulder, falling free so the gold jaal and navy tassels catch the light.
MUSE: a woman in her late twenties with long dark hair in a loose braid with a few jasmine flowers, gold choker, slim gold bangles; she reaches up on tiptoe, smiling with concentration.
MOMENT AND PLACE: Dusk on a wooden balcony of an old house: she stands reaching up to steady a glowing paper akash kandil hung above her, a string of fairy lights along the railing.
LIGHT: Blue dusk with the lantern's warm glow falling on her face and the teal saree.
COVER FRAMING (this photograph becomes one tall, narrow panel of the lookbook's opening page, behind a large title):
- POSE: she is standing upright, full length, head to toe in frame; ignore any seated or kneeling pose mentioned above.
- HEADROOM: the top quarter of the frame is calm, empty background (sky, wall, foliage or soft darkness); her head sits about a quarter of the way down, never near the top edge.
- Subject centred horizontally and filling the middle third of the width, so a narrow vertical crop keeps all of her.
- Keep the background simple and softly out of focus; nothing busy behind her face.
- CAMERA: eye level, 50mm lens at f/2.8, gentle depth of field, medium-format look with fine grain.
